title: Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility — Benefit-Year Exposure and the Arrangement Deposit
content:
**Schedule.** Exposure points are added to the deposit percentage of an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility arrangement deposit according to the patient charges posted on the coverage account in the current benefit year. A charge counts when the whole calendar months between its posting date and the handling date do not exceed the whole calendar months between the coverage record's benefit-year start and the handling date.

| Patient charges posted in the current benefit year (total) | Points added to the deposit percentage |
|---|---|
| at least 2500.00 | 4 |
| at least 500.00 but less than 2500.00 | 2 |
| less than 500.00 | 0 |

The points raise the deposit percentage itself, applied once to the balance.

**Which charges count (hypothetical dates).** Benefit-year start 1 January, handling date 20 August: 7 whole calendar months separate the two. A charge posted 5 January (7 whole months before 20 August) counts; a charge posted 18 December of the prior year (8 whole months before) does not.

**Boundaries (hypothetical totals).** 2500.00 adds 4; 2499.99 adds 2; 500.00 adds 2; 499.99 adds none.
